top_signals.title: America’s Biggest Oil Export Port Faces Thousands of Cyberattack Attempts
top_signals.summary: The port that ships most of America's crude oil overseas is now fending off "hundreds or even thousands" of attempts to break into its systems every day, Port of Corpus Christi CEO Kent Britton told the Financial Times, as hackers step up a campaign against US ports and the cargo ships that call on them. The stakes at Corpus Christi are hard to overstate: about 60% of US crude exports, roughly 2.3 million barrels a day, flow out of the Texas port, Britton said in May. top_signals.title: Nvidia Rehires Huang in Stunning Comeback
top_signals.summary: Nvidia’s board reinstated Jensen Huang as head of the world’s largest chipmaker in one of the most startling corporate comebacks in history, sending the stock on its biggest rally in decades. Ed Ludlow explains how we got here (Source: Bloomberg)
